title: kbmon loads redact's known names after the panels' bound, so --timeout 1 returns in about 5 s
goal: a kbmon run returns within its --timeout plus a fixed margin, the redaction's load of known names included (bounded, or loaded only when a printed string needs it)

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
def k(*a,env=None):
    t0=time.time();p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env or os.environ,timeout=120);p.wall=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return p
p=k('--json','--panel','coord','--timeout','1')
print('%.1f s'%p.wall);sys.exit(1 if p.wall>3 else 0)
